title: Property Play: Sonny Kalsi on AI, apartments and the data center debate
raw_text:
Property Play: Sonny Kalsi on AI, apartments and the data center debate
CNBC Property Play brings you interviews with some of the biggest names in real estate, touching on everything from commercial and residential to finance and the mortgage markets, innovation in the industry and the growing risk to assets and operations from climate change.
Diana Olick sits down with a global real estate investment heavyweight, Sonny Kalsi, CEO of SLC Management, to unpack where smart money is moving now. From the long-term case for multifamily housing and industrial logistics to the cautious optimism around data centers, life sciences and AI.
Watch the full interview, and sign up to receive the weekly Property Play newsletter, straight to your inbox.
